> The request was well-formed and syntactically valid, so parsing succeeded, but the data failed validation or violated a business rule.

A missing required field, a string where a number belongs, an email that is not an email, a date in the past where a future one is needed. Read the response body, because a well-built API names the failing field and often the exact path to it. Do not retry the same payload, since a 422 is deterministic and will fail identically.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/http-422-unprocessable-entity/
